questions.title: GATE ME — Machine Design | Design Against Static & Fatigue Loads
questions.subject: Machine Design
questions.question: In design against fluctuating fatigue loads, the Goodman relation connects mean stress $\sigma_m$, stress amplitude $\sigma_a$, endurance limit $S_e$, and ultimate tensile strength $S_{ut}$ via:
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Machine Design):

Goodman's straight line equation for fatigue failure under fluctuating stress: $\frac{\sigma_a}{S_e} + \frac{\sigma_m}{S_{ut}} = \frac{1}{N}$.

questions.title: GATE ME — Machine Design | Bearings, Brakes & Clutches
questions.subject: Machine Design
questions.question: A deep groove ball bearing operates under an equivalent radial load $P = 5\text{ kN}$. The basic dynamic load rating is $C = 25\text{ kN}$. The rated life of the bearing (in millions of revolutions, $L_{10} = (C/P)^p$ with $p = 3$) is ________.
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Machine Design):

For ball bearings ($p = 3$): $L_{10} = \left(\frac{C}{P}\right)^3 = \left(\frac{25}{5}\right)^3 = 5^3 = 125\text{ million revolutions}$.
